description: This file is a shell script that tests the behavior of session ID capabilities within a Git repository environment. It sets up repositories, runs fetch and push commands, and verifies whether session IDs are advertised as expected under different configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of its command sequence.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to be performed after the test case.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with a message.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
